l-e-h1-b06-02.title: Da wane abu ake zaɓar relative adverb?
l-e-h1-b06-02.goal: Gano ma'aunin (bayanin) da ake buƙata da gaske don zaɓen relative adverbs where, when, why, sannan bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-h1-b06-02.material: I remember the day when we met. This is the place where we met. Nobody knows the reason why we met. where, when, why: nemo ma'aunin zaɓensu.

l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.r.b: Tense ba ya bambance where, when, da why.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.o.c: Ko sunan da ake komawa gare shi wuri ne, lokaci ne, ko dalili
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.r.d: Waƙafi ba ya yanke shawarar relative adverb.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s1.explain: Yi amfani da where ga wuri, when ga lokaci, why kuma ga dalili. Duba irin sunan da ya gabata.
l-e-h1-b06-02.s.s2.model.0: Place yana ɗaukar where, day yana ɗaukar when, reason kuma yana ɗaukar why; saboda haka nau'in antecedent shi ne ma'aunin.

l-e-h1-b06-26.material: A: Feeling tired, I went to bed. B: Entering the room, I turned on the light. Nemo ma'aunin bambance ma'anar participle phrases biyun.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.prompt: Me kowace participle phrase ke nunawa?
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.o.a: A lokaci ne, B dalili ne
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.r.a: Mutumin ya kwanta saboda gajiya, don haka A dalili ne.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.o.b: A dalili ne, B lokaci ne
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.r.c: B tana magana kan lokacin kunna fitila yayin shiga ɗaki.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.r.d: Babu kalmar da ke nuna sharadi.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s1.explain: A na nufin dalili, kwanciya saboda gajiya, B kuma na nufin lokaci, kunna fitila yayin shiga ɗaki.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s2.model.0: Gajiya ce dalilin kwanciya, don haka A dalili ne; an kunna fitila lokacin shiga ɗaki, don haka B lokaci ne.
l-e-h1-b06-26.s.s2.model.1: Ma'anar participle phrase dangantakarta da babban sashen jimla ne ke ƙayyadewa, don haka a duba ko sashen farko sanadin na biyu ne ko lokaci.

l-e-h1-b06-34.title: Wanne BA fi'ili ne na ji da ba kasafai ake amfani da shi a progressive ba?
l-e-h1-b06-34.goal: Don gano state verbs da ba kasafai ake amfani da su a progressive ba, yanke shawarar wane ma'auni (bayanin) ake buƙata da gaske, sannan bayyana dalili.
l-e-h1-b06-34.material: Cikin know, believe, own, da run, nemo wanda ba state verb ba ne da ba kasafai ake amfani da shi a progressive (be -ing) ba.

l-e-h1-b06-34.s.s1.r.b: Yana bayyana yanayi; saboda haka yawanci ba a amfani da shi a progressive.

l-e-h1-b06-34.s.s1.explain: run aikin motsi ne, saboda haka progressive yana da sautin dabi'a. Sauran suna nuna yanayi.
l-e-h1-b06-34.s.s2.model.0: run aiki ne; saboda haka progressive kamar is running yana da ma'ana, sauran kuma yanayi ne; run kaɗai ya bambanta.
l-e-h1-b06-34.s.s2.model.1: know, believe, da own suna bayyana yanayi mai ɗorewa, saboda haka ba a amfani da progressive; run ba haka yake ba.

l-e-h1-b07-02.title: ‘Who’ ko ‘whom’, me ya kamata mu duba?
l-e-h1-b07-02.topic: Relative clause mai saka wani clause a ciki
l-e-h1-b07-02.goal: Don zaɓar ‘who’ ko ‘whom’ a relative clause mai saka ‘I think’ a ciki, ƙayyade ma’aunin (bayani) da ake buƙata da gaske, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-e-h1-b07-02.material: Wannan shi ne mawaƙin ___ nake tsammani ya fi ƙwarewa a makarantarmu. Saka ko ‘who’ ko ‘whom’ a gurbin.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Don bambance ‘who’ da ‘whom’, me ya kamata a bincika?
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.o.a: Ko ‘is’ yana zuwa bayan gurbin ba tare da subject ba, ko da an cire ‘I think’.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: Idan mutum ne, ‘who’ da ‘whom’ duka za su iya zama zaɓi; saboda haka ba za ka bambance su da wannan ba.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.o.c: Ko mawaƙi ɗaya ne ko da yawa.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: Adadi ba shi ne yake bambance ‘who’ da ‘whom’ ba.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Kasancewar an saka shi a ciki ba ya ƙayyade case ɗin.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Idan aka cire ‘I think’, ya zama ‘...singer ___ is the most talented’; saboda haka gurbin shi ne subject na ‘is’. Don haka ‘who’ ne.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Idan aka cire ‘I think’, fi’ilin ‘is’ yana zuwa kai tsaye bayan gurbin; saboda haka gurbin matsayin subject ne, kuma ‘who’ ya dace.
l-e-h1-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: Mutum ne ga ‘who’ da ‘whom’ duka; saboda haka a bincika ko shi ne subject na fi’ilin.

l-e-h1-b01-11.title: Yaushe za a iya barin relative pronoun?
l-e-h1-b01-11.goal: Gano da bayyana ƙa'ida daga misalai da yawa na barin relative pronoun, sannan gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h1-b01-11.material: Ana iya barinsa: the book (that) I read, the song (which) she wrote. Ba za a iya barinsa ba: the girl who sings, the dog that barks.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙa'ida ce ta dace da dukkan misalan?
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.a: Ana iya barin that amma ba who ba
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.r.a: Akwai misalin da aka bar which ma (the song she wrote).
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.b: Ana iya barinsa idan mai aikatawa ya zo bayan relative pronoun
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.c: Ana iya barinsa ne kawai idan abu ne
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.r.c: The dog that barks ba abu ba ne, kuma ba za a iya barin that ba.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.o.d: Ana iya barinsa idan jimlar gajera ce
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.r.d: Tsawo ba shi da alaƙa da barinsa.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s1.explain: Bayan kalmar that da aka bari, mai aikatawa (I, she) ne ke zuwa; bayan that da ba za a bari ba, fi'ili (sings, barks) ne ke zuwa.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s2.model.0: Idan mai aikatawa ya zo bayansa, kamar I read da she wrote, kalmar tana matsayin abin da aka yi wa aiki; saboda haka ana iya barinta.
l-e-h1-b01-11.s.s2.model.1: Idan fi'ili ya biyo bayanta kai tsaye, kamar sings da barks, relative pronoun ɗin shi ne mai aikatawa; saboda haka ba za a iya barinsa ba.

l-e-h1-b01-15.title: Yadda ake amfani da past progressive da simple past
l-e-h1-b01-15.goal: Daga misalai da dama, gano da bayyana ƙa'idar yadda ake amfani da past progressive da simple past, sannan a gwada ƙa'idar a wani sabon misali.
l-e-h1-b01-15.material: I was cooking when the phone rang. / While we were eating, the lights went out. / I cooked when the phone rang. (ma’ana na fara girki ne bayan wayar ta yi ƙara)
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙa’ida ce ta dace da jimlolin ukun?
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.a: Yi amfani da past progressive don abin da ke gudana, simple past kuma don abin da ya katse shi.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.b: Yi amfani da past progressive don abin da ya katse, simple past kuma don abin da ke faruwa a baya.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.b: ‘Rang’ da ‘went out’ su ne abubuwan da suka katse, kuma suna cikin simple past.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.c: Yi amfani da past progressive kaɗai ga abubuwan biyu.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.c: Kowace jimla tana amfani da simple past ma (‘rang’, ‘went out’).
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.o.d: Ma’anar ba ta canzawa ko da lokacin fi’ilin ya bambanta.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.r.d: Jimla ta uku tana da wata ma’ana dabam da ta farko.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s1.explain: Ana bayyana abin da ke gudana a matsayin abin da ke faruwa a baya da past progressive (‘was cooking’), abin da ya faru a lokacin kuma da simple past (‘rang’).
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s2.model.0: Abin da ke gudana, girki, shi ne ‘was cooking’; wayar da ta yi ƙara a tsakiyar lokacin kuwa ‘rang’ ce. Don haka abin da ke gudana yana cikin past progressive, abin da ya katse shi kuma simple past ne.
l-e-h1-b01-15.s.s2.model.1: ‘I cooked’ yana nufin na fara girki bayan wayar ta yi ƙara; saboda haka za ka ga cewa lokacin fi’ili yana sauya ma’ana.

l-e-h1-b02-11.title: Ƙa'idar quantity expression + of which/whom
l-e-h1-b02-11.goal: Nemo kuma ka faɗi ƙa'idar daga misalai da dama na yadda ake amfani da of which da of whom, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.a: Ana amfani da of which ga mutane, of whom kuma ga abubuwa.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.r.a: An yi amfani da of which ga abubuwa (littattafai, motoci), of whom kuma ga mutane (mambobi).
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.b: Bayan furucin adadi, yana nuna wani ɓangare na dukan abin da aka ambata a baya.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.c: Aikatau a cikin relative clause kullum yana cikin sigar guda ɗaya.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: Aikin da ya gabata yana canzawa gwargwadon adadin da ke gabansa, kamar were, are, is.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.o.d: Ana amfani da of whom da of which ne a farkon jimla kawai
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: An yi amfani da kalmomin duka a tsakiyar jimla.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s1.explain: Kamar two of which da most of whom, suna nuni da wani ɓangare na gabaɗayan abin da aka ambata tun farko.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: Suna nuni da wani ɓangare na gabaɗaya, kamar littattafai biyu cikin biyar da yawancin mambobi 20; saboda haka ƙa'ida ɗaya ce.
l-e-h1-b02-11.s.s2.model.1: of which ko of whom bayan kalmar adadi tana komawa ga sunan da ya gabata, saboda haka tana nuna wani ɓangare.

l-e-h1-b02-12.title: Abin da ke zuwa bayan although da despite
l-e-h1-b02-12.goal: Gano da bayyana ƙa'ida daga misalai da yawa na abin da ke zuwa bayan although da despite, sannan gwada ƙa'idar da sabon misali.
l-e-h1-b02-12.material: Daidai: Although it was cold, we swam. / Despite the cold, we swam. Ba daidai ba: Despite it was cold, we swam. / Although the cold, we swam.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙa'ida ce ta dace da jimlolin misalan?
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.a: Ƙaramin jimla tana zuwa bayan although da despite duka
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.r.a: “Despite it was cold” ɗaya ce daga jimlolin misali marasa daidaito.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.b: Ƙaramin jimla tana zuwa bayan although, suna kuma zuwa bayan despite
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.c: although tana zuwa ne kawai a tsakiyar jimla
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.r.c: A cikin jimlar misali madaidaiciya, an yi amfani da although a farkon jimla.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.o.d: despite tana da ma'anar kishiyar although
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Bayan although ana sanya mai aikatawa da fi'ili, bayan despite kuma ana sanya suna (ko gungun suna). Ma'anarsu ɗaya ce.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Misalan daidai kawai su ne “Although it was cold” a matsayin ƙaramin jimla da “Despite the cold” a matsayin gungun suna; wannan ita ce ƙa'idar.
l-e-h1-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: Misalan da ba daidai ba sun yi kuskure domin sun sanya ƙaramin jimla bayan despite da gungun suna bayan although; daga nan za a ga ƙa'idar.

l-e-h1-b05-11.title: Ta yaya ‘so’ da ‘such’ suka bambanta?
l-e-h1-b05-11.goal: Daga misalai da dama na yadda ake amfani da ‘so ~ that’ da ‘such ~ that’, gano ƙa’ida ka bayyana ta, sannan ka gwada ta da sabon misali.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.o.a: Ana amfani da ‘so’ kawai a jimla tabbatacciya, ‘such’ kuma kawai a jimla musantacciya.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.r.a: Dukkan jimloli huɗun jimloli tabbatattu ne.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.o.b: Bayan ‘so’ adjective kawai ake amfani da shi; bayan ‘such’ kuma (a) + adjective + noun.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.o.c: Ana iya musanya ‘so’ da ‘such’ a wuri ɗaya.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.r.c: Jimlolin da aka musanya (✗) ba daidai ba ne.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.o.d: ‘So a long trip’ ma furuci ne daidai.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.r.d: Jimlar da ke da ‘so a long trip’ tana da alamar ✗.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s1.explain: Bayan ‘so’ adjective kaɗai ke zuwa. Bayan ‘such’ kuma (a) + adjective + noun ke zuwa.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s2.model.0: ‘So tired’ tana da adjective kawai, ‘such a long trip’ kuma tana da noun; saboda haka bambancin ya danganta da kalmar da ke biye.
l-e-h1-b05-11.s.s2.model.1: Jimlolin da ke da ✗ ba daidai ba ne saboda noun ya zo bayan ‘so’ ko adjective kaɗai ya zo bayan ‘such’.

l-e-h1-b05-35.s.s2.model.1: Ko da abin na gaba ne, kada a saka will bayan when da after; ƙaramin jimlar lokaci tana amfani da present tense.

l-e-h1-b06-19.title: Ta yaya za ka gane halin marubuci?
l-e-h1-b06-19.goal: Nemo ƙa'ida daga misalai da dama na halin marubuci da kalmomi ke nunawa, faɗi ta sannan ka gwada da sabon misali.

l-e-h1-b06-19.s.s1.o.b: Dubi yawan periods a ƙarshen jimla
l-e-h1-b06-19.s.s1.r.b: Dukkan jimlolin ukun suna da period guda.
l-e-h1-b06-19.s.s1.o.c: Dubi jin daɗi ko rashin jin daɗin da kalmomin ke bayarwa
l-e-h1-b06-19.s.s1.r.d: Rubutu ba shi da alaƙa da hali.

l-e-h1-b06-19.s.s2.model.0: Cramped da stuffy ba su da kyau, cozy da snug kuma suna da kyau, saboda haka jin daɗin kalmomi yana bayyana hali.

l-e-h1-b06-27.s.s2.model.1: Ana bambance -ing da -ed bisa ko suna yana yin aikin ko aikin yana samunsa, don haka dangantakar ce ma'auni.

l-e-h1-b07-03.title: Gano ƙa’idar ‘whether’ da ‘if’
l-e-h1-b07-03.goal: Daga misalai da dama na ‘whether’ da ‘if’ da ke gabatar da noun clause, gano ƙa’ida ka bayyana ta, sannan ka gwada ƙa’idar a sabon misali.
l-e-h1-b07-03.material: ○ ‘I wonder if the shop is open.’ ○ ‘I wonder whether the shop is open.’ ○ ‘Whether the shop is open is unclear.’ × ‘If the shop is open is unclear.’ Gano ƙa’idar ka cika gurbin.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.prompt: ___ the plan works depends on the weather. Wace kalma ce ta dace da gurbin?
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.r.a: ‘Unless’ na nufin ‘if not’, saboda haka sharadi ne. Ba zai iya zama a matsayin subject ba.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.r.b: ‘Because’ yana gabatar da dalili; saboda haka ba zai iya zama subject na ‘depends’ ba.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.r.d: ‘If clause’ ba zai iya zama subject na jimla ba (misali na ƙarshe mai ×).
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s1.explain: A matsayin noun clause na subject, ‘whether’ ce kaɗai ake amfani da ita. ‘If’ na iya zuwa ne kawai a matsayin object na fi’ili kamar ‘wonder’.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s2.model.0: A misalan, ‘Whether’ kaɗai ce ke da ○, ‘If’ kuma × ce idan tana matsayin subject; saboda haka a yi amfani da ‘Whether’ a gurbin ma.
l-e-h1-b07-03.s.s2.model.1: ‘If’ ta bayyana ne kawai a matsayin object bayan ‘wonder’; saboda haka jimlar nan mai gurbin matsayin subject take buƙatar ‘Whether’.

So people bring their own bags. ① Jimlar farko ta ce jaka suna ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo kafin su lalace. ② Jimla ta biyu ta ce shaguna suna karɓar kuɗi. ③ Mafi takamaimai, jimlar farko ita kaɗai ce babban ra'ayi.

l-e-h1-b02-23.s.s2.model.0: Jimla ta farko ƙarin bayani guda ne kawai, saboda haka ③ ba daidai ba ne; babban ra’ayi kuwa shi ne abin da ya haɗa jimlolin ukun.

l-e-h1-b04-05.goal: Bi matakan warware I was reading when the lights went out., ko sarkar sanadi da sakamako, don nemo da gyara wurin farko da aka yi kuskure.

Wannan bayani ne na zaɓar lokacin aikatau. ① Karatun yana ci gaba lokacin da hasken ya mutu ② Mutuwar hasken abu ne na ɗan lokaci ③ Aikin da ke ci gaba yana amfani da simple past, abin ɗan lokaci kuma da past progressive ④ Saboda haka I read when the lights were going out daidai ne.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.o.a: ① Karatun yana ci gaba lokacin da hasken ya mutu
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.r.a: Ya dace da ma'anar jimlar. Wannan matakin daidai ne.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.r.b: Ya dace da ma'anar jimlar. Wannan matakin daidai ne.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.o.b: ② Mutuwar hasken abu ne na ɗan lokaci
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.o.c: ③ Aikin da ke ci gaba simple past ne, na ɗan lokaci kuma past progressive ne
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan sakamako ne kawai da ya fito daga ③, ba wurin kuskuren farko ba.
l-e-h1-b04-05.s.s1.explain: Aikin da ke ci gaba yana amfani da past progressive (was reading), abin ɗan lokaci da ya katse shi kuma simple past (went out). ③ ta juya ƙa'idar.

l-e-h1-b04-13.title: Gyara ‘whoever’: a ina ne aka yi kuskure?
l-e-h1-b04-13.goal: Bi mafitar jimlar ‘Give it to whoever needs it’ ko jerin dalili da sakamako mataki-mataki, sannan gano da gyara wurin farko da aka yi kuskure.
l-e-h1-b04-13.material: Jimla: ‘Give it to whoever needs it.’ Dalibi ya ce a sauya ta zuwa ‘whomever’. ① Bayan ‘to’ jimlar ‘whoever needs it’ gaba ɗaya ce ke zuwa ② Tunda jimlar gaba ɗaya object ce bayan ‘to’, shi ya sa ‘whoever’ a cikinta ma dole ne ya zama object ③ Don haka a mayar da ita ‘whomever’ ④ ‘Give it to whomever needs it’
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.o.a: ① Bayan ‘to’ dukkan ‘whoever clause’ ne ke zuwa.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.r.a: Tsarin jimla da clause ya zo bayan ‘to’ daidai ne. Wannan matakin ya dace.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.o.b: ② ‘Whoever’ da ke cikin clause ɗin ma dole ne ya kasance a object case.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.o.c: ③ Don haka a sauya shi zuwa ‘whomever’.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.r.c: Wannan sakamakon ② ne kawai, ba wurin farko da aka yi kuskure ba.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s1.explain: A cikin clause ɗin, ‘whoever’ shi ne subject na ‘needs’. Ko da clause ɗin gaba ɗaya object ne bayan ‘to’, ana tantance case bisa aikin kalmar a cikin clause ɗin.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s2.model.0: A cikin clause ɗin, ‘whoever’ shi ne subject na ‘needs’, saboda haka subject case ake buƙata; amma ② ta yanke hukunci bisa matsayin clause ɗin gaba ɗaya.
l-e-h1-b04-13.s.s2.model.1: ‘Whoever clause’ tana da ayyuka dabam-dabam a ciki da wajen clause; kuskuren ya faru a ②, kuma ‘whoever’ ne daidai.

l-e-h1-b05-05.title: Gyara since clause: a ina aka yi kuskure?
l-e-h1-b05-05.goal: Bi mafitar I have been happy since I moved here., ko sarkar sanadi da sakamako, mataki-mataki, sannan ka nemo wurin farko da ya yi kuskure ka gyara shi.
l-e-h1-b05-05.material: Jimla: I have been happy since I moved here. Ɗalibi ya ce a sauya moved zuwa have moved. ① Babban sashen jimla yanayi ne da ya ci gaba har yanzu, don haka present perfect ya dace ② Clause bayan since ma dole ta yi amfani da present perfect ③ Don haka a gyara zuwa since I have moved here ④ Wannan ita ce amsa.
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.o.a: ① Babban sashen jimla yanayi ne mai ci gaba, saboda haka present perfect
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.r.a: Bayani kan babban sashen jimla daidai ne. Wannan mataki daidai ne.
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.o.b: ② Since clause ma dole ta yi amfani da present perfect
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.o.c: ③ Gyara shi zuwa since I have moved here
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.o.d: ④ Karɓi wannan a matsayin amsa
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s1.explain: Clause bayan since da ke nuna lokacin farawa tana cikin lokacin baya. Moving here wani takamaiman abu ne da ya faru a baya.
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s2.model.0: Clause bayan since abin baya ne da ke nuna lokacin farawa, saboda haka moved na baya daidai ne kuma ② ba daidai ba ne.
l-e-h1-b05-05.s.s2.model.1: Ana bayyana present perfect ne a babban jumla; saboda haka ba dole ba ne since clause ɗin ma ya yi amfani da present perfect.

l-e-h1-b05-13.s.s2.model.1: Relative pronoun yana wakiltar object; sake amfani da ‘him’ yana maimaita abu ɗaya.

l-e-h1-b07-07.goal: Kwatanta hanyoyi ko ra’ayoyi biyu game da adadin fi’ilin da ke biye da ‘the + past participle’, zaɓi wanda ya fi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka.
l-e-h1-b07-07.material: ‘The injured ___ taken to the hospital.’ A: ‘Injured’ adjective ce, saboda haka a yi amfani da fi’ilin ɗaya ‘was’. B: ‘The injured’ na nufin ‘mutanen da suka ji rauni’, saboda haka a yi amfani da fi’ilin jam’i ‘were’.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.o.a: A: Adjective ce, saboda haka tana buƙatar fi’ilin ɗaya.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.r.a: ‘The + participle’ ba ya nufin abu guda; yana nufin ‘mutanen da suka ~’.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.o.b: B: Yana nufin ‘mutanen da suka ji rauni’, saboda haka yana buƙatar fi’ilin jam’i.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.r.c: ‘Was’ da ‘were’ ba za su iya zama daidai a jimla guda ba.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.o.d: Dukansu ba daidai ba ne, ‘injureds’ ne daidai.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.r.d: Kada a ƙara -s ga participle; yi amfani da ‘the injured’ yadda yake.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s1.explain: ‘The + past participle’ ana ɗaukar sa jam’i, ma’anarsa ‘mutanen da suka ~’ ce. Saboda haka ‘were’ daidai ne.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s2.model.0: ‘The injured’ na nufin mutane da dama da suka ji rauni; saboda haka dole ne a yi amfani da fi’ilin jam’i ‘were’.
l-e-h1-b07-07.s.s2.model.1: Ko da ‘injured’ adjective ne, idan aka yi amfani da shi tare da ‘the’ yana nufin mutane; saboda haka B ya fi dacewa.
